questions.stem: Which Frost talent now gives 2%, 4% or 6% hit with all spells?
questions.explanation: Precision in the Frost tree now improves hit with all spells by 2%, 4% or 6%. Blizzard removed Arcane Focus and Piercing Ice.

questions.stem: Which talent is now the 21-point Frost talent?
questions.explanation: Cold Snap is the 21-point Frost talent, with a 10 min cooldown. Ice Block is the 16-point talent, and Ice Barrier needs Cold Snap.

questions.stem: A Fire Mage keeps Improved Scorch stacked on the boss. Who benefits from those stacks in Forever?
choices: Only the Mage who applies them
questions.explanation: Improved Scorch and Winter's Chill now help only the Mage who applies them, so one Mage no longer keeps Scorch up for the whole raid.

questions.stem: Which reagent does Warcraft Tavern list for Mage portals?
questions.explanation: Portals use Rune of Portals. Rune of Teleportation is the reagent for teleports.

questions.stem: At what level does an Alliance Mage learn Teleport: Darnassus?
questions.explanation: Teleport: Darnassus comes at 30. Teleport: Stormwind and Teleport: Ironforge come at 20; portals follow at 40 and 50.

questions.stem: According to beta reports, what does a failed Comprehend Scroll decipher do?
questions.explanation: Warcraft Tavern's beta reports say a failed decipher turns you into a sheep until the skill improves. Returning books to librarians is what unlocks Research.

questions.stem: Which racial gives a Gnome Mage an 8 sec buff that makes non-periodic abilities 10% cheaper and stronger?
questions.explanation: Gnome Eureka! is the 8 sec buff. Ruthless is the Human crit racial and Wind-Blessed the Skyborne haste racial.

questions.stem: A High Order Skyborne Mage enters a raid. Which racial bonus is removed?
questions.explanation: Skyborne's Attuned bonus is removed when you enter a raid. Wind-Blessed, +2% haste, stays.

questions.stem: In the talentsforever datamine, how much of your mana regeneration does Mage Armor let continue while casting?
questions.explanation: The datamine reads 50% for Mage Armor. 30% is the Classic value.

questions.stem: You have Frost Channeling at 3/3. How much cheaper are your Frost spells?
questions.explanation: Frost Channeling at 3/3 makes Frost spells cost 15% less mana and cause 30% less threat. 5% is the rank 1 value.

questions.stem: How many players does Hyjal Summit take?
questions.explanation: Hyjal Summit is a 20-player raid. The Barrow Deeps takes 10 and Onyxia's Lair 40.

questions.stem: Which Mage buff covers the party and the raid in the files?
questions.explanation: The files show Arcane Brilliance reaching the party and the raid. Arcane Intellect is reported as still cast per group, so check it in game.

questions.stem: How long do your Arcane Blast stacks last?
questions.explanation: The Arcane Blast stack lasts 18 seconds from the first cast. 6 sec is Arcane Wrath's cooldown and 3.5 sec its cast time.

questions.stem: Arcane Wrath gains spell damage equal to what share of your maximum mana?
questions.explanation: Arcane Wrath gains spell damage equal to 5% of your maximum mana. 12% of Intellect and a 100% cost increase belong to each Arcane Blast stack.

questions.stem: Arcane Subtlety at rank 1 lowers your target's resistance to all your spells by how much?
questions.explanation: Rank 1 lowers the target's resistance by 8 and the threat of your Arcane spells by 15%. Rank 2 gives 15 and 30%.

questions.stem: With Improved Channeling at 5/5, what chance do Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath have not to lose casting time when you take damage?
questions.explanation: At 5/5 Arcane Missiles gets 100% and Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath get 70%. 56% is the rank 4 value.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, what was the spell hit cap against bosses three levels higher?
questions.explanation: The Classic 1.12 reference is 16% spell hit against bosses three levels higher, with 1% of spells always missing. 6% is what Precision gives at 3/3 in Forever.

questions.stem: Each Arcane Blast stack adds what share of your Intellect as Spell Damage?
questions.explanation: Each stack adds 12% of Intellect as Spell Damage and raises Arcane Blast's cost by 100%. 5% is Arcane Wrath's share of maximum mana.

questions.stem: Which profession makes healing potions in Forever, according to Warcraft Tavern?
questions.explanation: Healing potions moved from Alchemy to First Aid. Alchemists now brew flasks at a portable Alchemy Laboratory.

questions.stem: How much less threat do your Arcane spells cause with Arcane Subtlety at rank 2?
questions.explanation: Arcane Subtlety cuts Arcane threat by 15% at rank 1 and 30% at rank 2.

questions.stem: An Arcane PvP build wants Ice Block. Blizzard calls Ice Block the Frost talent at how many points?
questions.explanation: Ice Block is the 16-point Frost talent, so the build puts 16 points in Frost. Cold Snap is the 21-point one.

questions.stem: Arcane Mind at 5/5 raises the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by how much?
questions.explanation: At 5/5 Arcane Mind adds 100% to the crit damage bonus and 10% to your Intellect. 80% is the rank 4 value.

questions.stem: Arcane Wrath's extra spell damage scales with which of these?
questions.explanation: Arcane Wrath gains spell damage equal to 5% of your maximum mana. Intellect is what Arcane Blast converts into spell damage.

questions.stem: With Improved Scorch at rank 1, how often does Scorch make the target vulnerable to your Fire damage?
questions.explanation: Rank 1 gives a 33% chance, rank 2 67% and rank 3 every time (100%).

questions.stem: You have 3 Heating Up stacks. How long is your next Pyroblast's cast?
questions.explanation: Each stack cuts Pyroblast's cast by 25%, so 3 stacks bring it to 1.5 sec. 6 sec is the base cast, and 20 sec is how long the buff lasts.

questions.stem: How many talent points does the Fire tree hold?
questions.explanation: The Fire tree holds 46 points. Arcane holds 45 and Frost 48.

questions.stem: Improved Fire Blast at rank 1 adds how much range to Fire Blast?
questions.explanation: Rank 1 adds 8 yards and cuts the cooldown by 1 sec; rank 2 adds 15 yards and 2 sec.

questions.stem: Critical Mass now stops at three points. How much crit does it give there?
questions.explanation: Critical Mass caps at three points for 6% crit. 10% is what five points in Incineration give its spells.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, what share of spells always missed, whatever your hit?
questions.explanation: In the Classic 1.12 reference 1% of spells always miss. 16% was the spell hit cap against bosses three levels higher.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, how much fire resistance did the Onyxia Scale Cloak give?
questions.explanation: The Classic 1.12 reference gives the Onyxia Scale Cloak +16. The Drakefire Amulet, Juju Ember and the Greater Fire Resistance enchant give +15.

questions.stem: Fire Power at rank 1 adds 1% Fire damage per Fire effect on the target, up to what maximum?
questions.explanation: Rank 1 stops at 4%. At 3/3 it is 3% per effect, up to 12%.

questions.stem: What is Impact's chance to stun at rank 1?
questions.explanation: Impact gives your Fire spells a 3% stun chance at rank 1, 7% at rank 2 and 10% at rank 3.

questions.stem: In Blizzard's example, how much do Frostfire Bolt crits deal with Ignite plus Ice Shards?
questions.explanation: Frostfire Bolt counts as Fire and Frost, so Ignite and Ice Shards both apply: Blizzard's example gives 280%. 300% is Ice Lance's bonus against Frozen targets.

questions.stem: How much extra damage does Ice Lance deal to Frozen targets?
questions.explanation: Frozen targets take Ice Lance's restored 300% damage bonus. 280% is Blizzard's Frostfire Bolt crit example, and 15% is Fingers of Frost's proc chance.

questions.stem: How long does Ice Block protect you?
questions.explanation: Ice Block protects you for 10 sec, and you cannot act during it. 5 min is its cooldown.

questions.stem: What is Cold Snap's cooldown in the current talent data?
questions.explanation: Cold Snap has a 10 min cooldown. 5 min is Ice Block's cooldown and 30 sec is Ice Barrier's.

questions.stem: Shatter at rank 1 adds how much crit chance against Frozen targets?
questions.explanation: Shatter gives 17% at rank 1, 33% at rank 2 and 50% at rank 3.

questions.stem: Which spell shares an 8-second cooldown with Ice Lance?
questions.explanation: Ice Lance and Fire Blast share an 8-second cooldown. Frostfire Bolt is a separate cast.

questions.stem: How many bottles of water does one Conjure Water cast make in Forever?
questions.explanation: Conjure Water makes 20 bottles per cast across 7 ranks. 18 was the Classic count of sweet rolls from Conjure Food rank 6, which now makes 20.

questions.stem: Casting Ice Barrier raises your Frost damage by how much for one minute?
questions.explanation: Ice Barrier raises Frost damage by 15% for one minute, and by another 5% while the barrier holds.

questions.stem: An enemy puts a Bane on you. Which Mage spell also removes Banes in Forever?
questions.explanation: Remove Lesser Curse also removes Banes in Forever. Arcane Brilliance is the Intellect buff.

questions.stem: Each Winter's Chill stack increases the damage your next Cone of Cold deals to the target by how much?
questions.explanation: Each stack adds 20% damage taken from your next Cone of Cold, and the Cone of Cold also gains 7% of your spell damage per stack.
